- **Price versus bonds.** NDX is 0.1% from its high and VIX is near 15, but the 10Y is 3.8bp from its 52W high and MOVE jumped to 113.60. Equities are pricing calm while rates are not. If they converge, it is usually equities that adjust, but I have no data here that says when.
- **Credit versus rates.** HY OAS fell to 3.10% and IG OAS to 0.85%. Credit is not confirming the rate stress. That is why the stage is 3 and not 4.
- **Narrow leadership.** NDX is at its high while DJI (−6.4%) and Russell 2000 (−7.3%) lag. The breadth reading is old (2026-09-22), so this gap is the only fresh breadth evidence.
- **TQQQ versus the index.** TQQQ RSI is 81.1, but NDX is only 0.1% below its high. The leveraged fund is more stretched than the index it tracks.

## TQQQ Read
- **Momentum:** RSI(14) is 81.1, overbought (above 70). It was 74.8 at the last read, so the stretch is growing. After five straight green days, a put seller gets little mean-reversion help, because the price is extended and not washed out. Premium rests on volatility, not on a dip.
- **Market structure:** SIDEWAYS. Spot is 0.3% below the 4-week high ($83.38) and 25.1% above the 4-week low ($66.42). RALLY needs more than 30% above the low (above about $86.35), so it is 3.9% short. DOWNTURN needs more than 20% below the high AND VXN of 25 or more. Neither holds (VXN is 21.70).
- **Trend:** Uptrend backdrop. Spot is above the 50DMA ($72.40, +14.80%) and the 200DMA (~$63.50, +30.9%). It is 5.24% below the 52-week high.
- **Volatility & premium environment:** VXN of 21.70 is up slightly from 21.20. Measured ATM IV is 65%, up from 56%, and IV/HV is 1.40, up from 1.22. Options cost about 1.4 times what the stock has actually moved, a wider cushion for sellers than at the last read. SKEW at 143.04 means downside protection is priced rich, which fattens put premium but flags tail worry. Swing risk is still high: the estimated 5-day move is ±9.2% on the IV estimate and ±6.5% on realised volatility.
- **Put-selling context: CAUTIOUS.** Premium is rich against realised volatility (IV/HV 1.40), but spot is at the top of a $16.96 four-week range after five straight gains, with RSI above 80. Rates are near post-2007 highs and MOVE is rising. It is not hostile: VIX is 15.31, the VIX curve is in contango, NDX is 3.6% above 30,000, credit spreads tightened, and news reads CLEAR. No scheduled catalyst falls inside five sessions.
